name: QoL Comp
description: Quality-of-life toggles for Gen 1, 2 and 3, every one starting at the normal game. Hold the d-pad to scroll menus, run with B, a quicker Pokémon Center, TMs that aren't used up, rename and relearn moves from the party menu, field moves without teaching them (only where they'd work), pick who leads a battle, rematch beaten trainers, normal-case text, a hidden-item twinkle, a muteable low-HP alarm, a centred Game Boy camera and full-screen GBA menus. Plus a START menu editor that also handles other mods' rows, and small always-on fixes: 999-item stacks, the owned count in shops and SELECT to swap party members. Options are reachable from the game's own OPTIONS screen as well as the Mod Manager.
